007import java.lang.reflect.Array;
008import java.util.Collection;

011import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentMap;
012import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicLong;
013import org.wpilib.telemetry.util.PathUtil;

019/**
020 * Telemetry sends information from the robot program to dashboards, debug tools, or log files.
021 *
022 * <p>For more advanced use cases, use the NetworkTables or DataLog APIs.
023 */
024public final class TelemetryTable {
025  private record StaticFieldLookup(Object value, String warning) {}
026
027  private record CachedEntry(TelemetryEntry entry, long resetGeneration) {}
028
029  private enum EntryMetadataKind {
030    KEEP_DUPLICATES,
031    PROPERTY
032  }
033
034  private static final ClassValue<StaticFieldLookup> s_structLookupCache =
035      new ClassValue<>() {
036        @Override
037        protected StaticFieldLookup computeValue(Class<?> type) {
038          return getStaticField(type, "struct");
039        }
040      };
041
042  private static final ClassValue<StaticFieldLookup> s_protoLookupCache =
043      new ClassValue<>() {
044        @Override
045        protected StaticFieldLookup computeValue(Class<?> type) {
046          return getStaticField(type, "proto");
047        }
048      };
049
050  private final String m_path;
051  private final TelemetryBackend m_backend;
052  private final ConcurrentMap<String, TelemetryTable> m_tableAliasesMap = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
053  private final ConcurrentMap<String, TelemetryTable> m_tablesMap = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
054  private final ConcurrentMap<String, CachedEntry> m_entriesMap = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
055  private String m_type;
056  private Boolean m_hasNonDiscardDescendant;
057  private final AtomicLong m_resetGeneration = new AtomicLong();
058
059  private static StaticFieldLookup getStaticField(Class<?> type, String fieldName) {
060    try {
061      return new StaticFieldLookup(type.getField(fieldName).get(null), null);
062    } catch (NoSuchFieldException e) {
063      return new StaticFieldLookup(
064          null, "could not get " + fieldName + " field for " + type.getName());
065    } catch (IllegalAccessException e) {
066      return new StaticFieldLookup(
067          null, "could not access " + fieldName + " field for " + type.getName());
068    }
069  }
070
071  /**
072   * Constructs a telemetry table.
073   *
074   * @param path path with trailing "/".
075   */
076  TelemetryTable(String path) {
077    this(path, null);
078  }
079
080  /**
081   * Constructs a root telemetry table that writes directly to a backend without using the global
082   * telemetry registry.
083   *
084   * @param backend telemetry backend
085   */
086  public TelemetryTable(TelemetryBackend backend) {
087    this("/", Objects.requireNonNull(backend));
088  }
089
090  private TelemetryTable(String path, TelemetryBackend backend) {
091    m_path = path;
092    m_backend = backend;
093  }
094
095  /** Clears the table's cached entries. */
096  void reset() {
097    synchronized (this) {
098      m_tableAliasesMap.clear();
099      m_tablesMap.clear();
100      m_entriesMap.clear();
101      m_type = null;
102      m_hasNonDiscardDescendant = null;
103      m_resetGeneration.incrementAndGet();
104    }
105  }
106
107  /**
108   * Gets the table path.
109   *
110   * @return path with trailing "/"
111   */
112  public String getPath() {
113    return m_path;
114  }
115
116  /**
117   * Sets the table type. TelemetryLoggable implementations can use this function to communicate the
118   * type of data in the table. Callers should check the return value and not log data if false is
119   * returned.
120   *
121   * @param typeString type string
122   * @return False if type mismatch.
123   */
124  public boolean setType(String typeString) {
125    for (; ; ) {
126      String expectedType = null;
127      long resetGeneration;
128      synchronized (this) {
129        if (m_type != null) {
130          if (m_type.equals(typeString)) {
131            return true;
132          }
133          expectedType = m_type;
134          resetGeneration = -1;
135        } else {
136          m_type = typeString;
137          resetGeneration = m_resetGeneration.get();
138        }
139      }
140      if (expectedType != null) {
141        typeMismatch(expectedType, typeString);
142        return false;
143      }
144
145      TelemetryEntry entry = getEntry(".type");
146      boolean publishType;
147      synchronized (this) {
148        publishType =
149            m_resetGeneration.get() == resetGeneration && Objects.equals(typeString, m_type);
150      }
151      if (publishType) {
152        if (!entry.isDiscard()) {
153          entry.logString(typeString, "string", 0);
154        }
155        return true;
156      }
157    }
158  }
159
160  private void typeMismatch(String expectedType, String typeString) {
161    TelemetryRegistry.reportWarning(
162        m_path, "table type mismatch, expected '" + expectedType + "', got '" + typeString + "'");
163  }
164
165  /**
166   * Gets the table type.
167   *
168   * @return Table type as set by setType(), or null if none set.
169   */
170  public String getType() {
171    synchronized (this) {
172      return m_type;
173    }
174  }
175
176  /**
177   * Gets a child telemetry table.
178   *
179   * @param name table name
180   * @return table
181   */
182  public TelemetryTable getTable(String name) {
183    TelemetryTable table = m_tableAliasesMap.get(name);
184    if (table != null) {
185      return table;
186    }
187
188    String path = getTablePath(name);
189    table = m_tablesMap.get(path);
190    if (table != null) {
191      TelemetryTable aliasTable = m_tableAliasesMap.putIfAbsent(name, table);
192      return aliasTable != null ? aliasTable : table;
193    }
194
195    TelemetryTable newTable =
196        m_backend != null ? new TelemetryTable(path, m_backend) : TelemetryRegistry.getTable(path);
197    table = m_tablesMap.putIfAbsent(path, newTable);
198    if (table == null) {
199      table = newTable;
200    }
201
202    TelemetryTable aliasTable = m_tableAliasesMap.putIfAbsent(name, table);
203    return aliasTable != null ? aliasTable : table;
204  }
205
206  private String getEntryPath(String name) {
207    return PathUtil.normalizeName(m_path + name);
208  }
209
210  private String getTablePath(String name) {
211    return PathUtil.normalizeTableName(m_path + name + "/");
212  }
213
214  /**
215   * Gets a telemetry entry.
216   *
217   * @param name name
218   * @return entry
219   */
220  private TelemetryEntry getEntry(String name) {
221    for (; ; ) {
222      CachedEntry cachedEntry = m_entriesMap.get(name);
223      if (cachedEntry != null) {
224        if (cachedEntry.resetGeneration() == m_resetGeneration.get()) {
225          return cachedEntry.entry();
226        }
227        m_entriesMap.remove(name, cachedEntry);
228        continue;
229      }
230
231      long resetGeneration = m_resetGeneration.get();
232      String path = getEntryPath(name);
233      TelemetryEntry newEntry =
234          m_backend != null ? m_backend.getEntry(path) : TelemetryRegistry.getEntry(path);
235      if (m_backend == null && !newEntry.isDiscard()) {
236        TelemetryRegistry.applyEntryMetadata(path, newEntry);
237      }
238
239      CachedEntry newCachedEntry = new CachedEntry(newEntry, resetGeneration);
240      cachedEntry = m_entriesMap.putIfAbsent(name, newCachedEntry);
241      if (cachedEntry == null) {
242        cachedEntry = newCachedEntry;
243      }
244      if (cachedEntry.resetGeneration() == m_resetGeneration.get()) {
245        return cachedEntry.entry();
246      }
247      m_entriesMap.remove(name, cachedEntry);
248    }
249  }
250
251  private void applyEntryMetadata(
252      String name, String path, EntryMetadataKind kind, String key, String value) {
253    for (; ; ) {
254      CachedEntry cachedEntry = m_entriesMap.get(name);
255      if (cachedEntry != null) {
256        if (cachedEntry.resetGeneration() == m_resetGeneration.get()) {
257          applyEntryMetadata(cachedEntry.entry(), kind, key, value);
258          return;
259        }
260        m_entriesMap.remove(name, cachedEntry);
261        continue;
262      }
263
264      long resetGeneration = m_resetGeneration.get();
265      TelemetryEntry newEntry =
266          m_backend != null ? m_backend.getEntry(path) : TelemetryRegistry.getEntry(path);
267      boolean metadataApplied = false;
268      if (m_backend == null && !newEntry.isDiscard()) {
269        TelemetryRegistry.applyEntryMetadata(path, newEntry);
270        metadataApplied = true;
271      }
272
273      CachedEntry newCachedEntry = new CachedEntry(newEntry, resetGeneration);
274      cachedEntry = m_entriesMap.putIfAbsent(name, newCachedEntry);
275      boolean inserted = cachedEntry == null;
276      if (cachedEntry == null) {
277        cachedEntry = newCachedEntry;
278      }
279      if (cachedEntry.resetGeneration() == m_resetGeneration.get()) {
280        if (!(inserted && metadataApplied)) {
281          applyEntryMetadata(cachedEntry.entry(), kind, key, value);
282        }
283        return;
284      }
285      m_entriesMap.remove(name, cachedEntry);
286    }
287  }
288
289  private void applyEntryMetadata(
290      TelemetryEntry entry, EntryMetadataKind kind, String key, String value) {
291    if (!entry.isDiscard()) {
292      if (kind == EntryMetadataKind.KEEP_DUPLICATES) {
293        entry.keepDuplicates();
294      } else {
295        entry.setProperty(key, value);
296      }
297    }
298  }
299
300  private boolean shouldLogTableValue(String name, TelemetryTable table) {
301    TelemetryEntry entry = getEntry(name);
302    return !entry.isDiscard() || m_backend == null && table.hasNonDiscardDescendant();
303  }
304
305  private boolean hasNonDiscardDescendant() {
306    for (; ; ) {
307      long resetGeneration;
308      synchronized (this) {
309        if (m_hasNonDiscardDescendant != null) {
310          return m_hasNonDiscardDescendant;
311        }
312        resetGeneration = m_resetGeneration.get();
313      }
314
315      boolean hasNonDiscardDescendant = TelemetryRegistry.hasNonDiscardDescendant(m_path);
316      synchronized (this) {
317        if (m_hasNonDiscardDescendant != null) {
318          return m_hasNonDiscardDescendant;
319        }
320        if (resetGeneration != m_resetGeneration.get()) {
321          continue;
322        }
323        m_hasNonDiscardDescendant = hasNonDiscardDescendant;
324        return m_hasNonDiscardDescendant;
325      }
326    }
327  }
328
329  /**
330   * Indicates duplicate values should be preserved. Normally duplicate values are ignored.
331   *
332   * @param name the name
333   */
334  public void keepDuplicates(String name) {
335    if (m_backend != null) {
336      TelemetryEntry entry = getEntry(name);
337      if (!entry.isDiscard()) {
338        entry.keepDuplicates();
339      }
340      return;
341    }
342
343    String path = getEntryPath(name);
344    boolean done = false;
345    while (!done) {
346      long resetGeneration = m_resetGeneration.get();
347      TelemetryRegistry.keepEntryDuplicates(path);
348      applyEntryMetadata(name, path, EntryMetadataKind.KEEP_DUPLICATES, null, null);
349      done = m_resetGeneration.get() == resetGeneration;
350    }
351  }
352
353  /**
354   * Sets property for a value. Properties are stored as a key/value map.
355   *
356   * @param name the name
357   * @param key property key
358   * @param value property value
359   */
360  public void setProperty(String name, String key, String value) {
361    if (m_backend != null) {
362      TelemetryEntry entry = getEntry(name);
363      if (!entry.isDiscard()) {
364        entry.setProperty(key, value);
365      }
366      return;
367    }
368
369    String path = getEntryPath(name);
370    boolean done = false;
371    while (!done) {
372      long resetGeneration = m_resetGeneration.get();
373      TelemetryRegistry.setEntryProperty(path, key, value);
374      applyEntryMetadata(name, path, EntryMetadataKind.PROPERTY, key, value);
375      done = m_resetGeneration.get() == resetGeneration;
376    }
377  }
378
379  /**
380   * Logs a generic object.
381   *
382   * <p>For non-null values, the value is dispatched in this order: {@link TelemetryLoggable},
383   * {@link org.wpilib.util.struct.StructSerializable}, {@link
384   * org.wpilib.util.protobuf.ProtobufSerializable}, boxed primitive and string types, and finally
385   * handlers registered with {@link TelemetryRegistry#registerTypeHandler(Class,
386   * TelemetryRegistry.TypeHandler)}. {@link TelemetryLoggable} values are logged to a child table
387   * named {@code name}. Struct and protobuf serializable values are logged with their public static
388   * {@code struct} or {@code proto} serializers. {@link Boolean}, {@link Float}, {@link Double},
389   * {@link Byte}, {@link Short}, {@link Integer}, {@link Long}, other {@link Number} values, and
390   * {@link String} are logged as primitive or string entries. Generic {@link Number} values other
391   * than boxed integral types are logged as double entries. If no registered handler matches, the
392   * value falls back to being logged as a string using {@link Object#toString()}. Collection values
393   * must be logged with an explicit element type.
394   *
395   * @param <T> data type
396   * @param name the name
397   * @param value the value; must be non-null
398   */
399  public <T> void log(String name, T value) {
400    switch (value) {
401      case TelemetryLoggable v -> {
402        TelemetryTable table = getTable(name);
403        if (!shouldLogTableValue(name, table)) {
404          return;
405        }
406        String typeString = v.getTelemetryType();
407        if (typeString != null && !table.setType(typeString)) {
408          return;
409        }
410        v.logTo(table);
411      }
412      case StructSerializable v -> {
413        TelemetryEntry entry = getEntry(name);
414        if (entry.isDiscard()) {
415          return;
416        }
417        var lookup = s_structLookupCache.get(v.getClass());
418        if (lookup.warning() != null) {
419          TelemetryRegistry.reportWarning(getEntryPath(name), lookup.warning());
420          return;
421        }
422        switch (lookup.value()) {
423          case Struct<?> s when s.getTypeClass().isAssignableFrom(value.getClass()) -> {
424            @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
425            Struct<? super T> s2 = (Struct<? super T>) s;
426            entry.logStruct(value, s2, 0);
427          }
428          case Struct<?> s ->
429              TelemetryRegistry.reportWarning(
430                  getEntryPath(name),
431                  "type mismatch, expected '"
432                      + s.getTypeClass().getName()
433                      + "', got '"
434                      + value.getClass().getName()
435                      + "'");
436          default ->
437              TelemetryRegistry.reportWarning(
438                  getEntryPath(name),
439                  "struct field for " + v.getClass().getName() + " is not of Struct<?> type");
440        }
441      }
442      case ProtobufSerializable v -> {
443        TelemetryEntry entry = getEntry(name);
444        if (entry.isDiscard()) {
445          return;
446        }
447        var lookup = s_protoLookupCache.get(v.getClass());
448        if (lookup.warning() != null) {
449          TelemetryRegistry.reportWarning(getEntryPath(name), lookup.warning());
450          return;
451        }
452        switch (lookup.value()) {
453          case Protobuf<?, ?> s when s.getTypeClass().isAssignableFrom(value.getClass()) -> {
454            @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
455            Protobuf<? super T, ?> s2 = (Protobuf<? super T, ?>) s;
456            entry.logProtobuf(value, s2, 0);
457          }
458          case Protobuf<?, ?> s ->
459              TelemetryRegistry.reportWarning(
460                  getEntryPath(name),
461                  "type mismatch, expected '"
462                      + s.getTypeClass().getName()
463                      + "', got '"
464                      + value.getClass().getName()
465                      + "'");
466          default ->
467              TelemetryRegistry.reportWarning(
468                  getEntryPath(name),
469                  "proto field for " + v.getClass().getName() + " is not of Protobuf<?, ?> type");
470        }
471      }
472      case Boolean v -> {
473        TelemetryEntry entry = getEntry(name);
474        if (!entry.isDiscard()) {
475          entry.logBoolean(v.booleanValue(), 0);
476        }
477      }
478      case Float v -> {
479        TelemetryEntry entry = getEntry(name);
480        if (!entry.isDiscard()) {
481          entry.logFloat(v.floatValue(), 0);
482        }
483      }
484      case Double v -> {
485        TelemetryEntry entry = getEntry(name);
486        if (!entry.isDiscard()) {
487          entry.logDouble(v.doubleValue(), 0);
488        }
489      }
490      case Byte v -> {
491        TelemetryEntry entry = getEntry(name);
492        if (!entry.isDiscard()) {
493          entry.logLong(v.longValue(), 0);
494        }
495      }
496      case Short v -> {
497        TelemetryEntry entry = getEntry(name);
498        if (!entry.isDiscard()) {
499          entry.logLong(v.longValue(), 0);
500        }
501      }
502      case Integer v -> {
503        TelemetryEntry entry = getEntry(name);
504        if (!entry.isDiscard()) {
505          entry.logLong(v.longValue(), 0);
506        }
507      }
508      case Long v -> {
509        TelemetryEntry entry = getEntry(name);
510        if (!entry.isDiscard()) {
511          entry.logLong(v.longValue(), 0);
512        }
513      }
514      case Number v -> {
515        TelemetryEntry entry = getEntry(name);
516        if (!entry.isDiscard()) {
517          entry.logDouble(v.doubleValue(), 0);
518        }
519      }
520      case String v -> {
521        TelemetryEntry entry = getEntry(name);
522        if (!entry.isDiscard()) {
523          entry.logString(v, "string", 0);
524        }
525      }
526      case Collection<?> _ -> {
527        TelemetryEntry entry = getEntry(name);
528        if (!entry.isDiscard()) {
529          TelemetryRegistry.reportWarning(
530              getEntryPath(name), "collection element type must be specified");
531        }
532      }
533      default -> {
534        // try other handlers
535        var handler = TelemetryRegistry.getTypeHandler(value);
536        if (handler != null) {
537          TelemetryTable table = getTable(name);
538          if (!shouldLogTableValue(name, table)) {
539            return;
540          }
541          handler.logTo(this, name, value);
542        } else {
543          // fall back to string
544          TelemetryEntry entry = getEntry(name);
545          if (!entry.isDiscard()) {
546            entry.logString(value.toString(), "string", 0);
547          }
548        }
549      }
550    }
551  }
552
553  /**
554   * Logs an object with a Struct serializer.
555   *
556   * @param <T> data type
557   * @param name the name
558   * @param value the value
559   * @param struct struct serializer for the value type or one of its supertypes
560   */
561  public <T> void log(String name, T value, Struct<? super T> struct) {
562    TelemetryEntry entry = getEntry(name);
563    if (entry.isDiscard()) {
564      return;
565    }
566    entry.logStruct(value, struct, 0);
567  }

569  /**
570   * Logs an object with a Protobuf serializer.
571   *
572   * @param <T> data type
573   * @param name the name
574   * @param value the value
575   * @param proto protobuf serializer for the value type or one of its supertypes
576   */
577  public <T> void log(String name, T value, Protobuf<? super T, ?> proto) {
578    TelemetryEntry entry = getEntry(name);
579    if (entry.isDiscard()) {

581    }

585  /**
586   * Logs a generic array.
587   *
588   * <p>{@link Byte} arrays are logged as raw byte arrays.
589   *
590   * @param <T> data type
591   * @param name the name
592   * @param value the value
593   */
594  public <T> void log(String name, T[] value) {
595    TelemetryEntry entry = getEntry(name);
596    if (entry.isDiscard()) {
597      return;
598    }
599    switch (value) {
600      case StructSerializable[] _ -> {
601        Class<?> componentType = value.getClass().getComponentType();
602        var lookup = s_structLookupCache.get(componentType);
603        if (lookup.warning() != null) {
604          TelemetryRegistry.reportWarning(getEntryPath(name), lookup.warning());
605          return;
606        }
607        switch (lookup.value()) {
608          case Struct<?> s when s.getTypeClass().isAssignableFrom(componentType) -> {
609            @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
610            Struct<? super T> s2 = (Struct<? super T>) s;
611            entry.logStructArray(value, s2, 0);
612          }
613          case Struct<?> s ->
614              TelemetryRegistry.reportWarning(
615                  getEntryPath(name),
616                  "type mismatch, expected '"
617                      + s.getTypeClass().getName()
618                      + "', got '"
619                      + value.getClass().getName()
620                      + "'");
621          default ->
622              TelemetryRegistry.reportWarning(
623                  getEntryPath(name),
624                  "struct field for " + componentType.getName() + " is not of Struct<?> type");
625        }
626      }
627      case Boolean[] v -> {
628        boolean[] arr = new boolean[v.length];
629        for (int i = 0; i < v.length; i++) {
630          arr[i] = v[i].booleanValue();
631        }
632        entry.logBooleanArray(arr, 0);
633      }
634      case Byte[] v -> {
635        byte[] arr = new byte[v.length];
636        for (int i = 0; i < v.length; i++) {
637          arr[i] = v[i].byteValue();
638        }
639        entry.logRaw(arr, "raw", 0);
640      }
641      case Float[] v -> {
642        float[] arr = new float[v.length];
643        for (int i = 0; i < v.length; i++) {
644          arr[i] = v[i].floatValue();
645        }
646        entry.logFloatArray(arr, 0);
647      }
648      case Double[] v -> {
649        double[] arr = new double[v.length];
650        for (int i = 0; i < v.length; i++) {
651          arr[i] = v[i].doubleValue();
652        }
653        entry.logDoubleArray(arr, 0);
654      }
655      case Number[] v -> {
656        logNumberArray(entry, v);
657      }
658      default -> {
659        // TODO: use other Object handler?
660        // fall back to string array
661        String[] strs = new String[value.length];
662        for (int i = 0; i < value.length; i++) {
663          strs[i] = String.valueOf(value[i]);
664        }
665        entry.logStringArray(strs, 0);
666      }
667    }
668  }

670  /**
671   * Logs an array of objects with a Struct serializer.

673   * @param <T> data type
674   * @param name the name

677   */
678  public <T> void log(String name, T[] value, Struct<? super T> struct) {

686  /**
687   * Rejects logging a collection without an explicit element type.
688   *
689   * <p>Use {@link #log(String, Collection, Class)} or {@link #log(String, Collection, Struct)}
690   * instead.
691   *
692   * @param name the name
693   * @param value the value
694   * @throws CollectionElementTypeRequiredException always
695   */
696  public void log(String name, Collection<?> value) throws CollectionElementTypeRequiredException {
697    throw new CollectionElementTypeRequiredException();
698  }
699
700  /**
701   * Logs a collection with an explicit element type.
702   *
703   * <p>The element type selects the backend representation. {@link Byte} element types are logged
704   * as raw byte arrays. {@link Boolean}, {@link Float}, {@link Double}, and {@link String} element
705   * types are logged like arrays of the same element type. {@link Number} and other non-integral
706   * number element types are logged as double arrays. {@link Short}, {@link Integer}, and {@link
707   * Long} element types are logged as integer arrays. {@link StructSerializable} element types are
708   * logged with their public static {@code struct} serializer. Other element types fall back to
709   * string arrays using {@link Object#toString()}.
710   *
711   * @param name the name
712   * @param value the value
713   * @param elementType the collection element type
714   */
715  public void log(String name, Collection<?> value, Class<?> elementType) {
716    Objects.requireNonNull(value, "value");
717    Objects.requireNonNull(elementType, "elementType");
718    TelemetryEntry entry = getEntry(name);
719    if (entry.isDiscard()) {
720      return;
721    }
722
723    if (isBooleanType(elementType)) {
724      logBooleanCollection(name, entry, value);
725    } else if (isByteType(elementType)) {
726      logByteCollection(name, entry, value);
727    } else if (isFloatType(elementType)) {
728      logFloatCollection(name, entry, value);
729    } else if (isDoubleType(elementType)) {
730      logDoubleCollection(name, entry, value);
731    } else if (isIntegralNumberType(elementType)) {
732      logLongCollection(name, entry, value);
733    } else if (isNumberType(elementType)) {
734      logDoubleCollection(name, entry, value);
735    } else if (elementType == String.class) {
736      logStringCollection(name, entry, value);
737    } else if (StructSerializable.class.isAssignableFrom(elementType)) {
738      var lookup = s_structLookupCache.get(elementType);
739      if (lookup.warning() != null) {
740        TelemetryRegistry.reportWarning(getEntryPath(name), lookup.warning());
741        return;
742      }
743      switch (lookup.value()) {
744        case Struct<?> s when s.getTypeClass().isAssignableFrom(elementType) ->
745            logStructCollection(name, entry, value, s);
746        case Struct<?> s ->
747            TelemetryRegistry.reportWarning(
748                getEntryPath(name),
749                "type mismatch, expected '"
750                    + s.getTypeClass().getName()
751                    + "', got '"
752                    + elementType.getName()
753                    + "'");
754        default ->
755            TelemetryRegistry.reportWarning(
756                getEntryPath(name),
757                "struct field for " + elementType.getName() + " is not of Struct<?> type");
758      }
759    } else {
760      logFallbackStringCollection(entry, value);
761    }
762  }

764  /**
765   * Logs a collection of objects with a Struct serializer.
766   *
767   * @param <T> data type
768   * @param name the name
769   * @param value the value
770   * @param struct struct serializer for the value type or one of its supertypes
771   */
772  public <T> void log(String name, Collection<T> value, Struct<? super T> struct) {
773    TelemetryEntry entry = getEntry(name);
774    if (entry.isDiscard()) {
775      return;
776    }
777    entry.logStructArray(toArray(value, struct.getTypeClass()), struct, 0);
778  }

1034  @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
1035  private static <T> T[] toArray(Collection<?> value, Class<?> componentType) {
1036    return value.toArray((T[]) Array.newInstance(componentType, value.size()));
1037  }
1038
1039  private static boolean isBooleanType(Class<?> type) {
1040    return type == Boolean.class || type == Boolean.TYPE;
1041  }
1042
1043  private static boolean isByteType(Class<?> type) {
1044    return type == Byte.class || type == Byte.TYPE;
1045  }
1046
1047  private static boolean isFloatType(Class<?> type) {
1048    return type == Float.class || type == Float.TYPE;
1049  }
1050
1051  private static boolean isDoubleType(Class<?> type) {
1052    return type == Double.class || type == Double.TYPE;
1053  }
1054
1055  private static boolean isIntegralNumberType(Class<?> type) {
1056    return type == Short.class
1057        || type == Short.TYPE
1058        || type == Integer.class
1059        || type == Integer.TYPE
1060        || type == Long.class
1061        || type == Long.TYPE;
1062  }
1063
1064  private static boolean isNumberType(Class<?> type) {
1065    return Number.class.isAssignableFrom(type);
1066  }
1067
1068  private void logBooleanCollection(String name, TelemetryEntry entry, Collection<?> value) {
1069    boolean[] arr = new boolean[value.size()];
1070    int i = 0;
1071    for (Object element : value) {
1072      if (!(element instanceof Boolean v)) {
1073        collectionElementTypeMismatch(name, Boolean.class, element);
1074        return;
1075      }
1076      arr[i++] = v;
1077    }
1078    entry.logBooleanArray(arr, 0);
1079  }
1080

1085      if (!(element instanceof Number v)) {
1086        collectionElementTypeMismatch(name, Number.class, element);
1087        return;
1088      }
1089      arr[i++] = v.byteValue();
1090    }
1091    entry.logRaw(arr, "raw", 0);
1092  }

1146  private void logStructCollection(
1147      String name, TelemetryEntry entry, Collection<?> value, Struct<?> struct) {
1148    logStructCollectionImpl(name, entry, value, struct);
1149  }
1150
1151  private <T> void logStructCollectionImpl(
1152      String name, TelemetryEntry entry, Collection<?> value, Struct<T> struct) {
1153    try {
1154      entry.logStructArray(toArray(value, struct.getTypeClass()), struct, 0);
1155    } catch (ArrayStoreException e) {
1156      collectionElementTypeMismatch(name, struct.getTypeClass(), null);
1157    }
1158  }
1159
1160  private static void logFallbackStringCollection(TelemetryEntry entry, Collection<?> value) {
1161    String[] strs = new String[value.size()];
1162    int i = 0;
1163    for (Object element : value) {
1164      strs[i++] = String.valueOf(element);
1165    }
1166    entry.logStringArray(strs, 0);
1167  }
1168
1169  private void collectionElementTypeMismatch(String name, Class<?> expectedType, Object element) {
1170    TelemetryRegistry.reportWarning(
1171        getEntryPath(name),
1172        "collection element type mismatch, expected '"
1173            + expectedType.getName()
1174            + "', got '"
1175            + (element == null ? "null" : element.getClass().getName())
1176            + "'");
1177  }
1178
1179  private static void logNumberArray(TelemetryEntry entry, Number[] value) {
1180    if (isIntegralNumberType(value.getClass().getComponentType())) {
1181      long[] arr = new long[value.length];
1182      for (int i = 0; i < value.length; i++) {
1183        arr[i] = value[i].longValue();
1184      }
1185      entry.logLongArray(arr, 0);
1186    } else {
1187      double[] arr = new double[value.length];
1188      for (int i = 0; i < value.length; i++) {
1189        arr[i] = value[i].doubleValue();
1190      }
1191      entry.logDoubleArray(arr, 0);
1192    }
1193  }
1194}
